defect.cause: Canonical closestOpponent computes math.sqrt for every eligible enemy while comparing distances. Dense PvE scans O(N) candidates per unit each simulation step, repeating unnecessary square-root operations.
defect.reproduction: Run the complete canonical server through tests/roblox_server_harness.lua and extract the original closestOpponent closure from the actual updateEntity function. Six eligible enemies cause six sqrt calls in the old implementation; a pinned old whole-server fixture provides a negative control when available.

fix: Compare squared x/z distances for all living opponents, then compute sqrt once for the selected closest target; return nil and math.huge unchanged when no target exists. Preserve nearest-target tie behavior, combat ranges and unit statistics.
character_impact: PON, GUARDON, TANKURU and JUNK target selection keeps the same nearest eligible opponent and Euclidean distance; no cost, HP, speed, cooldown, damage, appearance or remote changes. Only repeated square-root work is removed.

tests.negative_control: Pinned pre-change whole-server fixture checks six sqrt calls if present; the canonical whole-server test checks one or zero.

evidence.main_qa_note: Both jobs succeeded; db8a6f19 is a status-only descendant.

next_action: Create a draft PR; require latest-head offline and compile_hold success before independent REVIEWER merge. Hardware performance and Roblox engine behavior remain unverified.
